rules: Zero-knowledge: the server never sees plaintext. Never log, persist or transmit the Vault Key, Master Key or password; only opaque encrypted fields and SRP proofs leave packages/core/src/encryption.
Column conventions: PK = UUIDv7 TEXT generated client-side; timestamps = Unix ms INTEGER; money = INTEGER cents; booleans = INTEGER 0/1; calendar dates = TEXT YYYY-MM-DD; JSON = stringified TEXT.
Never add an inline `notes` column: notes live in `pages` via entity_type/entity_id.
Every syncable table spreads `...baseColumns` and `...syncColumns` from schema/_shared.ts; never hand-repeat the `_sync_*` columns.

Enums are `as const` tuples in @vida/types with the union type derived from the tuple; never a TS `enum` or a bare union. `z.enum(TUPLE)` in @vida/core and the SQL CHECK list are sourced from the tuple (enum-parity.test.ts enforces it).
Soft deletes only: `deleted_at INTEGER` (NULL = live).

Inside a `db.transaction` callback use only `tx` / `*InTx` APIs, never the outer `db` (nested lock → 30 s TransactionLockTimeoutError). Every write is transactional; never a bare insert/update/delete `.run()` outside a transaction.
Migrations are hand-written SQL in packages/core/src/db/migrations, forward-only (no down()), registered in runner.ts ALL_MIGRATIONS; never edit a merged migration, add the next number.
packages/core/src/db/_legacy, docs/_legacy and Old/ are quarantined reference-only code: never import or extend them.
ADR-001 … ADR-017 in docs/core/decisions/ govern; a downstream shape never reopens an ADR.
packages/ui/src/themes/{tokens,themes,fonts,motion,shadow}.ts are generated by build-tokens.mjs: change the source and rebuild, never hand-edit.
apps/web never registers a `beforeunload` listener (cancelable → a live page with a dead worker); teardown is pagehide/pageshow in db/boot.ts.
Never `pnpm rebuild` better-sqlite3: its ABI must match the running Node.
Services follow docs/core/architecture/data-flow.md (validate → repository → encrypt-seam → return) and ride packages/core/src/foundation substrates; never re-implement a substrate inside a module.
Branch `lif-<id>-<slug>`, PR description includes `Fixes LIF-<id>`, conventional commits (feat:/fix:/refactor:).

changeGuide.title: Read the governing docs
changeGuide.body: The owning ADR in docs/core/decisions/, the feature's five aspects under docs/features/<module>/ (identity · business-rules · contract · structure-data · conventions), any docs/modules/<module>/current-*.md, and the CLAUDE.md of every layer you touch. REPO.md maps where things live.

changeGuide.title: Trace the flow
changeGuide.body: Follow docs/core/architecture/data-flow.md from the UI read/write through the service, repository and encrypt seam; cross-module reads go through the shared foundation/views ViewProviderRegistry (docs/core/architecture/cross-module-integration.md).

changeGuide.title: Observe real state
changeGuide.body: `pnpm dev:app` for the local-first app (no server in M1). Live-store tests run over better-sqlite3; browser persistence uses the Playwright harness in apps/web/e2e (window.__vidaDb backdoor). Date code gets TZ-forced tests.

changeGuide.title: Where problems are written up
changeGuide.body: The Linear issue (team LIF); decisions in .claude/docs/decisions.md; recurring failures in .claude/knowledge/failure-patterns/known-failures.md.

changeGuide.title: Plan
changeGuide.body: Slice plans live in docs/features/<module>/delivery/PLAN-S*.md; registering a service in apps/web/src/db/composition-root.ts happens in the entity's closing slice (docs/specs/foundation/golive-replan/process.md, Entity Live Close).

changeGuide.title: Landmines
changeGuide.body: App-wide write lock (BR-RT-LOCK): no nested db.transaction. React Query errored queries need retryOnMount:false on state-swapped surfaces. Editing @vida/types needs a dist rebuild before @vida/core typecheck. better-sqlite3 ABI vs Node. macOS 12 cannot run the Chromium e2e locally: rely on CI.

changeGuide.title: Validate
changeGuide.body: `pnpm check` (format:check + lint + typecheck + test + e2e); packages/core has no lint script, so run eslint from the repo root. UI changes also pass the Visual Gate in a real browser.

operations.name: add-table
operations.summary: Add a new SQLite table to the local-first schema.
operations.when: A feature's structure-data.md defines a table that does not exist yet.
inputs: the feature's structure-data.md row for the table
rules: Column conventions: PK = UUIDv7 TEXT generated client-side; timestamps = Unix ms INTEGER; money = INTEGER cents; booleans = INTEGER 0/1; calendar dates = TEXT YYYY-MM-DD; JSON = stringified TEXT.
Every syncable table spreads `...baseColumns` and `...syncColumns` from schema/_shared.ts; never hand-repeat the `_sync_*` columns.

Enums are `as const` tuples in @vida/types with the union type derived from the tuple; never a TS `enum` or a bare union. `z.enum(TUPLE)` in @vida/core and the SQL CHECK list are sourced from the tuple (enum-parity.test.ts enforces it).
Never add an inline `notes` column: notes live in `pages` via entity_type/entity_id.
Migrations are hand-written SQL in packages/core/src/db/migrations, forward-only (no down()), registered in runner.ts ALL_MIGRATIONS; never edit a merged migration, add the next number.
steps: Read the governing ADR + the feature's structure-data.md and packages/core/src/db/CLAUDE.md.
Add the enum tuples and the entity interface (extends SyncableEntity, `/** @encrypted */` on [E] fields) to the domain file in packages/types/src, export from index.ts, rebuild @vida/types dist.
Add the Drizzle table to packages/core/src/db/schema/<domain>.ts with the _shared.ts helpers and CHECKs from the tuples; register its entity_type in _registry.ts if it is linkable.
Write the next-numbered migration in packages/core/src/db/migrations and append it to ALL_MIGRATIONS in runner.ts.
Add the z.enum validators in packages/core/src/validators and extend enum-parity.test.ts.
Write a better-sqlite3 test that migrates from scratch and round-trips a row through the repository.
Run `pnpm check`.

operations.name: add-service-method
operations.summary: Add or change a method on a @vida/core module service.
operations.when: A slice's business rules need new behaviour in packages/core/src/services/<module>.
inputs: the BR ids from docs/features/<module>/business-rules.md or current-business-rules.md
rules: Services follow docs/core/architecture/data-flow.md (validate → repository → encrypt-seam → return) and ride packages/core/src/foundation substrates; never re-implement a substrate inside a module.

Inside a `db.transaction` callback use only `tx` / `*InTx` APIs, never the outer `db` (nested lock → 30 s TransactionLockTimeoutError). Every write is transactional; never a bare insert/update/delete `.run()` outside a transaction.
Soft deletes only: `deleted_at INTEGER` (NULL = live).
steps: Read the module's CLAUDE.md, its current-spec/business-rules docs and the substrates' CLAUDE.md under packages/core/src/foundation.
Write the failing better-sqlite3 live-store test named after the BR.
Implement in the factory-object service (no `this.` for intra-calls): Zod-validate input, write via repository inside a transaction, return the domain shape.
Fan out effects/measurement through the foundation rails, best-effort side effects in their own try/catch after the durable write.
Update the module CLAUDE.md status and the current-* docs.
Run `pnpm check` (eslint from the repo root for packages/core).

operations.name: add-web-surface
operations.summary: Add a screen or surface to apps/web on @vida/ui.
operations.when: A slice ships user-visible UI in apps/web.
inputs: the frontend spec / specimen for the surface
the service reads and writes it uses
rules: apps/web never registers a `beforeunload` listener (cancelable → a live page with a dead worker); teardown is pagehide/pageshow in db/boot.ts.
packages/ui/src/themes/{tokens,themes,fonts,motion,shadow}.ts are generated by build-tokens.mjs: change the source and rebuild, never hand-edit.
steps: Read docs/specs/foundation/frontend-source-of-truth.md, docs/core/architecture/state-conventions.md and the CLAUDE.md of the apps/web/src area you touch.
Build from @vida/ui primitives and tokens; add a primitive to packages/ui only when no existing one fits.
Read through React Query over getServices() with honest loading/empty/error states (explicit Retry; retryOnMount:false where the surface swaps state).
Register any new service in apps/web/src/db/composition-root.ts only in the entity's closing slice.
Add the Vitest + Testing Library tests and a Playwright spec using apps/web/e2e/fixtures.ts.
Run the Visual Gate in a real browser (light + dark, 375/768/desktop), then `pnpm check`.

operations.name: fix-bug
operations.summary: Fix a reported defect with a regression test.
operations.when: A Linear issue or failing check reports wrong behaviour.
inputs: reproduction steps or the failing output
rules: Branch `lif-<id>-<slug>`, PR description includes `Fixes LIF-<id>`, conventional commits (feat:/fix:/refactor:).
steps: Read the error fully; classify it isolated or structural (structural → plan first and ask).
Check .claude/knowledge/failure-patterns/known-failures.md for the pattern.
Reproduce with a failing test at the lowest layer that shows it (TZ-forced for date code; Playwright for OPFS/worker behaviour).
State the root cause, apply the minimal fix, and grep for sibling call sites with the same defect.
Record a new recurring pattern in known-failures.md; run `pnpm check`.
